testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23081 edited sales rep username is shown in the listing and used to sign in

scenario.summary: The admin changes the username of a sales rep assigned to a user; the new username is shown on the listing, the sales rep signs in with it, and the assigned user still shows the sales rep.
steps: Open the sales rep's (@rep.userId) Manage page; click Edit next to Username.
Enter a new unique username (made up by the test from @rep.userName, run-ID tag kept); click Save; click Save and Close.
Find the new username on the Sales Rep listing.
Sign in as the sales rep with the new username and @rep.password.
Open the assigned user's (@assigned.userId) Manage User page; read its Sales Rep.
stateChanges: The sales rep's username is changed (the sales rep and the user are deleted at teardown by id).
assertions: The new username is saved and displayed on the Sales Rep listing
The sales rep signs in with the new username
The assigned user still shows the sales rep
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
FSD 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': a changed username is shown everywhere the sales rep is used.
Precondition 'assigned to at least one user': USER_ASSIGNED_TO_SALES_REP with rep = @rep.userId, checked on the user's Manage User Sales Rep field before the first step.
Step 8 ('if applicable'): Manage User shows the rep in its Sales Rep field; the test checks it still shows the renamed rep (assumption, analysis 8.2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
